Full-body front-view color character illustration based on the attached reference photos of the real Korean MMA fighter Kim Seung-yeon, stylized as a grounded anime character while keeping his real face, hair, build and left-arm tattoo sleeve recognizable. He stands relaxed but perfectly balanced with his weight even on both feet, arms hanging loosely at his sides, hands half open, chin level, a calm, cool, slightly sleepy-eyed face with a closed mouth. He is a 37-year-old Korean man, a former ROAD FC lightweight striker with a long karate background who now coaches at a small MMA gym: 180 cm, about 7.6 heads tall with realistic proportions, a tall, lean, long-limbed lightweight build with long arms and legs, a narrow waist, flat lean muscle on the shoulders and arms, not bulky. Light warm skin. A long narrow face with high defined cheekbones, a sharp narrow jaw and a slightly pointed chin, narrow single-lidded eyes with a calm half-lidded look, thin straight black eyebrows, a straight nose, thin lips, clean-shaven. Short black hair: the sides and back are closely shaved, the top is a little longer and brushed up and back. His real tattoo sleeve on his LEFT arm only, covering the arm from below the t-shirt sleeve down to the wrist, drawn as dense dark blue-grey ink shapes with no readable letters, symbols or faces; his right arm has no large tattoo. Outfit: a plain muted wine-burgundy short-sleeved gym t-shirt (#5C3B40), plain charcoal loose training pants (#333336) without stripes, bare feet. Plain unbranded clothing. Colors: light warm skin with mauve shadows, black hair, the muted wine t-shirt as the main tone and the charcoal pants; no orange anywhere. Plain warm off-white paper background (#F4EFE6) with a soft grounding shadow under the feet, whole body visible from hair to soles. Muted cinematic anime cel shading, like a still from a grounded theatrical anime film: flat colors with one crisp shadow tone (a second darker tone only under the chin and beneath the brow), skin shadows in soft mauve-brown, shadows on white cloth in cool blue-grey, soft pink flush on cheeks, nose tip, ears and knuckles. Bold, slightly rough warm near-black outlines (#1A1417), thick on the silhouette and thin inside. Low-to-medium saturation, no gradients on the character, no glossy highlights, no rim-light glow, no eye sparkle, very subtle paper grain.
